description: How links reach the app. `app_links` is the most important for integration work: it returns the iOS team id, bundle id, Android package and SHA-256 fingerprints that Fictura serves in the Universal Links / App Links association files, plus ios_ready and android_ready. Get these wrong and BOTH files fail SILENTLY — they parse, associate nothing, report no error, and links simply keep opening the browser instead of the app, so verify the ready flags rather than assuming. `domains` lists branded link domains and their DNS verification state, `web_config` the web-to-app smart banner, `esp` the email provider link setup.
